name: pp.test
title: Phillips-Perron Z(alpha) with the long lag. The p-value is interpolated on the Dickey-Fuller table.

origin.description: Phillips-Perron Z(alpha) with the long lag. The p-value is interpolated on the Dickey-Fuller table.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Phillips-Perron Z(alpha) with the long lag. The p-value is interpolated on the Dickey-Fuller table.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
p <- pp.test(sin((1:60)/3), lshort = FALSE)
paste(cell(p$statistic), cell(p$p.value), p$parameter, sep = "|")

translation.description: Phillips-Perron Z(alpha) with the long lag. The p-value is interpolated on the Dickey-Fuller table.

arguments.name: x

translation.details: Phillips-Perron Z(alpha) with the long lag. The p-value is interpolated on the Dickey-Fuller table.

translation.example:
